dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Hello, Nara friend! Um... I was supposed to tell you something, but I don't remember...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's okay. We are just happy to see you again!

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Well, thank you.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: She's not talking anymore, but she's doing well. Recovering too, the forest is... Thank you.

response.speaker: Aranaga
response.text: Forgetting...? Oh, because the power has been depleted, the Kusava. That's why it will flow away too, memory. Drop by drop, like dewdrops...

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Hello, and thank you! Golden Nara and White Floaty!

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: What are you guys doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You said to remember to come back and play together!

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Oh, did I say that...?

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Hello, Golden Nara and White Floaty!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hi! How've you been?

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Good! But why did you come here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh...?

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Well... It's troubling us. There must be a reason, but why you came here, I don't know...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're familiar with this place after all the adventures we had with you guys!

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: Oh... Really?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He doesn't remember our past experiences...

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Hello, Golden Nara! And you, Little White Floaty!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph! Paimon is not little! Take a look in the mirror!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Hey, I'm not little either! Oh, right, what are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We just came back to see you guys.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, we defeated a lot of bad guys in the past after all, and we sang together, and saved "M—Mootaya" together...

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Mawtiyima!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Oh... Sorry... What you guys are saying must be true, but I don't remember...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um...! I—It's okay! Don't be sad!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (He really doesn't remember...)

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Hello, hello!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello, little one! Still remember us?

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Darn White Floaty! I'm not a little one! Do you still remember the song I taught you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Of course.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Yes!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Then promise me that even if I forget my song... you'll remember it!

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Golden Nara, White Floaty! You're here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! We're here!

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Hehehe... I probably forgot many things, so I need you to remind me...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is it because of the Kusava?

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Yes... Aranaga should have mentioned it to you. Power is in memory, and no memory means no power...

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: So... We must have experienced something in the past, but we don't remember anymore...

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: Haha, but it's nothing to me! We can still start making new memories again, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes! That's the spirit!

dialogues.speaker: Aranaga
dialogues.text: #Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME} and White Floaty. But now, needs us, Mawtiyima.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Thank you! Don't forget to come see us! But we have to keep Mawtiyima company now, so next time!

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: #Bang bang! Ha! Nara {NICKNAME} and White Floaty are mighty! Happy to adventure with you! Thanks!
